root_cause.text: The loop condition in imx8m_blk_ctrl_remove() was written as `bc->onecell_data.num_domains` (always true) instead of `i < bc->onecell_data.num_domains`, causing an infinite loop and out-of-bounds access on the `bc->domains` array.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes the loop from `for (i = 0; bc->onecell_data.num_domains; i++)` to `for (i = 0; i < bc->onecell_data.num_domains; i++)`, fixing the out-of-range access.
